sources.supports: IFAAMAS lists AAMAS 2026 in Paphos, Cyprus, May 25–29, and its official site describes the annual series. No AAMAS 2027 event announcement was found in the official pages checked.
Official ACM MM site lists MM 2027 in Hong Kong with dates to be announced.

Official Important Dates page lists the 2026 main-track notification on July 9; its linked CFP page gives July 7, so the recorded date follows the Important Dates page and the discrepancy is noted. The 2026 event is listed in Rio de Janeiro, November 10–14.

Official 2026 CFP lists submission May 26, author response August 18–25, acceptance notification September 8, and paper chairs Nick Nikiforakis and Konrad Rieck. The conference home page lists December 7–11 in Los Angeles.

Official AIED 2026 dates page confirms abstract January 26, paper February 2, notification March 23; the event page locates the conference in Seoul. No official 2027 edition was found in the pages checked.

changes: Corrected ACM MM 2026 notification date to the series Important Dates page value and preserved the conflicting CFP date in a note.
Added the officially announced ACM MM 2027 Hong Kong edition with dates and CFP milestones left unknown.
Marked AAMAS, ACM MM, ACSAC, and AIED as partially audited because future-edition discovery or track-specific verification remains incomplete.
